title: ZK Reports
tagline: ZK Reports: Elevating document verification to a new level of security and privacy, revealing only what’s necessary, and protecting what matters most.
description: In today’s digital age, safeguarding your sensitive information while proving its authenticity is more critical than ever. ZK Reports is the revolutionary solution that empowers individuals and institutions to validate important documents without compromising data privacy. With ZK Reports, you can confidently showcase verified information without revealing unnecessary details, ensuring that only the essentials are disclosed to authorized parties.
how_its_made: We have used here noir for creating contract to prove that the balance of particular account is greater then the minimum required amount which help us to protect our private data from revealing it. Noir is a Domain Specific Language for SNARK proving systems. It has been designed to use any ACIR compatible proving system. Noir is similar to Rust so it's easy to implement if you know rust. For the frontend we have used React js with vite.
